text: 汇成真空公告，公司2026年度向特定对象发行A股股票事项的申请文件已获深交所受理。深交所核对后认为申请文件齐备，决定予以受理；该事项尚需深交所审核通过并获得中国证监会同意注册后方可实施。
text_en: Huicheng Vacuum announced that the application documents for the company's 2026 issuance of A-shares to specific targets have been accepted by the Shenzhen Stock Exchange. After verification, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange deemed the application documents complete and decided to accept them; the matter still requires approval by the Shenzhen Stock Exchange and registration consent from the CSRC before implementation.
